I answered Pree in a thread on their message in #central-random. I said the signed order form for Tansley Parcel is now due 3 April, replacing the date they posted in #central-team this morning.

They asked for no action, so I only replied there. I didn't post in #central-team or contact anyone else. The deadline is a signing date, not a money term, so it was fine to mention in that channel.
